verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a transcription API service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers transcription modes, vocabulary, auth scopes, IP allowlists and webhooks, but documents no control for opting out of telemetry, usage tracking, or data retention for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
